_about: Data for the combined station js/cook/stations/maani-line.js: dough bowls -> chakla -> tawa on one screen. `station` is its name and goal line (merged into data.stations); `words` are merged into data.words only if missing (ph-big/ph-small are in data/cook.json: wadho/nindho, with she-forms wadhi/nindhi for maani); `mechanic.levels` are its difficulty levels (each lists only what changes). doughs: the two bowls, always both, whatever the order (tint multiplies the dough and maani art: millet dough is greyer). ballsPerBowl: always more than any order asks for, and the same in both bowls, so the bowls never show the count. sizes: null (one dashed circle, the roll knob's radius) or {wordId: radius} (two dashed circles; the order says which size). quietMs: how long a pause ends a roll (longer with two sizes, so you can roll on past the small circle). zones: which level each zone's mechanic runs at (tawa level 2 = two tawas). Wave 6 levels, each adding one thing: 1 one maani, 2 two, 3 a second tawa, 4 big/small. The order's own levels (how many, which kinds) are in data/cook.json recipes.maani.slots.maani.byLevel.

station.name: Maani line
station.goal: Tap a dough bowl, roll the dough to the circle, then tap it onto the tawa. Flip on the green, tap again to puff. Tick when you've made what they asked for.
